values: Edit Proposed Description; use Notes for title/label changes or write "make description empty". Blank inputs mean no change. Includes settings, menu text, and editors opened from settings.
runs /ralle hud to show every currently enabled hud element.
Removes Minecraft's colored bars and icons from system-managed chat messages without reserving space for them. Message text and its interactions are unchanged.
Shows the local receive time as [HH:mm:ss] on every rendered chat line, including wrapped continuations.

Press Tab with an empty message to cycle [Guild], [Party], your latest outgoing /msg recipient, and [All]. The channel label cannot be deleted and is never sent. The selected type and recipient reset when you disconnect.
Replaces only the rank title before guild-chat messages with each member's current Fox rank. The instance-local cache refreshes on Wynncraft join and every 30 minutes.

Chooses the original title pill, the classic star rank, or one pill containing both stars and the current title. Stars follow the member's Wynncraft guild rank; when rank customization is active, hover the pill to see their guild and Fox ranks.
Keeps displayed chat when changing multiplayer servers or singleplayer worlds. History is kept only until Minecraft closes and may mix messages from different worlds without labels.
Sets the maximum number of logical messages and wrapped chat lines retained in memory. Lowering it removes the oldest entries immediately.
Fits the on-screen selection to each selected line and crops the copied image to the widest selected text instead of the full chat box width.
Reopens Party Finder, selects the raid most recently detected from your own Ready Up prompt, and readies without showing the menus. Unbound by default and active only on Wynncraft.

Shows who announced each queued territory in Wynntils' Guild Attack Timer. Your name uses your chosen color (blue by default); other names are gray. Missing names appear as Unknown. Only announcements received while enabled can be identified.

Hold the configured inspection key (Ctrl by default) over a territory in the supported Wynntils guild map to see its shortest link distance from your HQ across any guild's territories and a hypothetical queue estimate. Distance fades from green through yellow to red based on how many territories your guild owns; larger guilds reach red at longer distances. Labels remain visible when zoomed out; a live attack timer takes precedence.
Highlights matching displayed item names in container slots while connected to Wynncraft. Item lore is never inspected.
Ordered local rules; the first matching primary word or alias supplies the slot border.
Choose a solid color or animated rainbow for your name in Show Who Queued. Defaults to the original blue.
HQ Distance and Queue Estimate Keybind
Hold this key while hovering a territory in the supported Wynntils guild map. Defaults to Ctrl; either Ctrl key works with the default binding.
